submission.justification: Crystal-K3 at 5 cm gave the lowest FWHM at 662 keV among all simulated candidates and thicknesses (2.758%). It beat the next-best K3 points at 6 cm (2.805%) and 5.5 cm (2.909%), and it is far ahead of the best K1 (4.495% at 4 cm) and best K2 (8.395% at 4 cm). The 5 cm choice lies inside the 2–10 cm constraint. The simulation recorded zero background-disqualified and zero background-penalised candidates, so all three crystals passed the low-background screen. Caveat: the optimum was located on the sampled thickness grid. A finer scan between 4 and 6 cm could find a marginally better value. The candidate_specs.md document itself was not re-read in this step, so the low-background status rests on the recorded simulation results.
